title: falconmute
description: FalconMute is a lightweight chat moderation plugin that provides server administrators with efficient and reliable tools to manage player communications and issue mutes.
body:
# FalconMute

**FalconMute** is a lightweight, efficient, and user-friendly chat moderation plugin designed to give server administrators complete control over their server's communication. Whether you are dealing with spammers, toxic players, or just need to enforce your community guidelines, FalconMute provides the essential tools to manage chat effectively without adding unnecessary bloat to your server.

## ✨ Features

* **Simple Command Structure:** Intuitive and straightforward commands that your staff team can learn and use instantly.
* **Lightweight Performance:** Optimized to run smoothly with minimal impact on your server's resources.
* **Reliable Enforcement:** Instantly stops muted players from sending messages in the global chat.

## 💻 Commands

* `/mute <player>` - Prevents a specific player from sending chat messages.
* `/unmute <player>` - Restores a previously muted player's ability to chat.

## 🔑 Permissions

* `falconmute.mute` - Grants the ability to use the mute command.
* `falconmute.unmute` - Grants the ability to use the unmute command.

## 🐛 Issues & Support

If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or want to suggest new features, please report them on the official issue tracker:
[GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/yourcatismine/FalconMute/issues)
